edits.after:
if (le32_to_cpu(eb->h_fs_generation) != OCFS2_SB(sb)->fs_generation)
		rc = ocfs2_error(sb,
				 "Extent block #%llu has an invalid h_fs_generation of #%u\n",
				 (unsigned long long)bh->b_blocknr,
				 le32_to_cpu(eb->h_fs_generation));

	if (le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_next_free_rec) >
	    le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_count))
		rc = ocfs2_error(sb,
				 "Extent block #%llu has next free rec %u > count %u\n",
				 (unsigned long long)bh->b_blocknr,
				 le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_next_free_rec),
				 le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_count));

	if (le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_count) > (sb->s_blocksize -
			offsetof(struct ocfs2_extent_block, h_list.l_recs)) /
			sizeof(struct ocfs2_extent_rec))
		rc = ocfs2_error(sb,
				 "Extent block #%llu has count %u > max %lu\n",
				 (unsigned long long)bh->b_blocknr,
				 le16_to_cpu(eb->h_list.l_count),
				 (sb->s_blocksize - offsetof(struct ocfs2_extent_block,
							     h_list.l_recs)) /
				 sizeof(struct ocfs2_extent_rec));
bail:
	return rc;
}
